_comment: LinkedIn Jobs searches (read-only). The query set changes only through a query probe (/hunt-probe, docs/query-probe-method.md): decision rules written before the data, a dated report, then this file. verified stays false until a probe verifies the set; the tick refuses until then. The schedule (tz, days, hours) comes from profile/preferences.json.

defaults._why: Defaults for a one-off `npm run jobs -- search` from the command line; configured queries name their own geo and workplace.

canary._why: Example only. The canary is a productive query on the AI search endpoint: an empty page without the no-results marker signals throttling or selector rot.

queries._why: Example only, replaced by the onboarding probe.
